title: ItemEditor
description: In-game item editor with GUI, attributes and text formatting
body:
**ItemEditor** is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that allows you to quickly and easily edit items directly in-game through a graphical interface.

No more setting up servers, typing long commands, or using external plugins — now you can create custom items in just a few seconds.

---

## ⚙️ Features

* 🧱 Edit the item in your hand
* ✏️ Change item name with full `&` color and formatting support
* 📜 Customize item lore (description)
* 🔢 Modify item count
* 🔍 Search through attributes

---

## 🧪 Attributes

Supports core item attributes:

* Unbreakable
* Glint Override
* Hide Tooltip
* Hide Additional Tooltip
* Damage
* Custom Model Data
* Max Stack Size
* Max Damage

---

## 🎨 Text Formatting

Supports standard `&` formatting codes:

* Colors: `&0` – `&f`
* Bold: `&l`
* Italic: `&o`
* Underline: `&n`
* Strikethrough: `&m`
* Obfuscated: `&k`
* Reset: `&r`

---

## ⚡ How to Use

1. Hold an item in your hand
2. Press the key (default: **K**)
3. Open the editor GUI
4. Modify the item
5. Click **"Apply"**

---

## 🌐 Compatibility

* Works as a **client-side mod**
* Does not require installation on the server
* Requires **operator (OP) permissions** to modify items

---

## ⚠️ Important

Items with excessive data may cause performance issues or even chunk corruption.
The mod will warn you when approaching unsafe limits.

---

## 💡 Use Cases

* Creating custom items
* Testing mechanics
* Map making and mini-games
* Server administration

---

## 🚀 Planned Features

* Potion effects editor
